how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-mountain-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3906:details:0: The elders have felt a disturbance amongst the elements. The Dark Iron dwarves have summoned a foul spirit into our world that threatens to plague our lands with an eternal draught. This disharmony of flame must be investigated.
rows.quest:3906:details:1: ⟦E1⟧ to ⟦E2⟧, through the Chasm of Flame, into the quarry. It is there that you shall find this lord of fire: ⟦E3⟧.

rows.quest:3906:progress:0: The elements are still in disarray, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:3906:completion:0: This cannot be... it must not be. The destruction of Pyron has merely lifted a veil. Within the depths of Blackrock is a much more insidious source of corruption.
rows.quest:4262:obj:1: You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?
rows.quest:4262:details:0: The last five of my mages that went snooping around in ⟦E2⟧ came back extra crispy with a permanent orange gnomefro - or worse.
rows.quest:4262:details:1: B<Jalinda picks up some ashes from the ground and releases them into the air.>
rows.quest:4262:details:2: One nasty bugger in particular, ⟦E3⟧, seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. We need that elemental terminated so that our expedition crew can make its way into ⟦E6⟧!

rows.quest:4262:progress:0: <Jalinda appears to be staring at your head.>

rows.quest:8961:details:0: In order to summon ⟦E16⟧ we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.

Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a ⟦E15⟧, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
rows.quest:8961:progress:0: It was our folly... our doom that we took that last job. If only we hadn't inadvertently stolen ⟦E16⟧'s spirit, which was contained in the amulet; if only there weren't those in our mercenary group that had been so greedy and divided it up amongst themselves. I'd be alive today, maybe tossing back a beer, or tossing one of my kids into the air.⟦4⟧⟦5⟧⟦6⟧, don't let the avarice of the ignoble in our old mercenary company be your doom as well.

rows.quest:8994:obj:0: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a ⟦E41⟧. Return them to ⟦E8⟧ inside ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8994:details:0: We're nearly there, ⟦33⟧. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:8994:details:1: To begin I must ask you to journey forth into ⟦E9⟧ and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a ⟦E41⟧.
rows.quest:8994:progress:0: We've come a long way, ⟦35⟧, and I just wanted to say that no matter what happens, thank you! You've put yourself in mortal danger to try to help the surviving members of our mercenary company, The Veiled Blade, and as far as I'm concerned, you're one of us now.
rows.quest:8994:completion:0: That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon ⟦E16⟧, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.
rows.quest:8994:completion:1: You've come quite a distance, ⟦36⟧, don't falter now that the end is in sight!
rows.quest:8996:details:0: I will ignore your impertinence this time, ⟦37⟧, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, ⟦38⟧, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
rows.quest:8996:details:1: Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
rows.quest:8996:progress:0: ⟦39⟧, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.⟦40⟧⟦41⟧You're going to have to tell me all about it!
rows.quest:8996:completion:0: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.
rows.quest:8996:completion:1: This is a great day, ⟦42⟧! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.
rows.quest:8996:completion:2: Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.
